children: RIYADH — A team from the Saudi Center for Organ Transplantation (SCOT), in coordination with the organ donation unit at King Saud Medical City, successfully performed the Kingdom's first corneal retrieval from a deceased donor following cardiac death.

The retrieved corneas were transported to the Eye Bank at King Abdulaziz Medical City under the Ministry of National Guard for evaluation, processing, and preservation before transplantation, in line with approved medical quality standards.

The procedure marks the first tangible milestone of a pilot initiative launched on August 10, 2026, in collaboration with both medical cities. The initiative aims to expand corneal donation opportunities, bolster sustainable supplies, and restore sight to patients requiring transplants.

SCOT Director General Dr. Talal Algoufi commended the participating medical teams. He expressed optimism that the achievement will foster a wider culture of corneal donation and encourage more hospitals to join the national initiative.
